subsystem.name: RuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Generic runtime object and CRT-compatible facilities: mutex-guarded queue draining, FILE-style buffered stream I/O, string and number parsing and formatting, character normalization, allocation dispatch, error-code mapping, bitfield encoding, FPU rounding, and callback registration stubs.

summary: A heterogeneous set of generic runtime facilities: a shutdown-time mutex-guarded dual-queue drain, six callback-registration stubs delegating to a shared conversion helper, a FILE-layout CRT stream family (close/seek/tell/buffered write), a critical-section-guarded buffered stream primitive family, string and FPU number helpers, a network session parameter configurator, allocation/free dispatch, and CRT error-code mapping.

function_roles.role: Drain two mutex-guarded item queues at shutdown: pop-and-dispatch items via vtable slot 0x5C, then drain an embedded singly-linked list under the mutex at this+0x58C with SEH-guarded payload cleanup, releasing the mutex on return.
Registration thunk: passes the address of a cleanup routine (sub_585E70) to the shared BooleanToIntConversion helper and returns its integer result.
Seeded init registering five bitmap-allocation tracker entries on member offsets 52..68 of this and finalizing bitmap fields; returns this.
Set or clear a single bit (a2) in the byte array whose base is at this[0]; a3 selects set vs clear; returns the resulting mask byte.
Encode a run of bits into the buffer at *this using a run descriptor from the array at this+0x8, masked by the caller mask a3; returns 1 on success.
Trivial side-effect-free getter returning the dword at byte offset 0x14 of this.
Registration thunk: passes the address of a static-init routine (sub_587410) to the shared BooleanToIntConversion helper.
Registration thunk: passes the address of a cleanup routine (sub_587450) to the shared BooleanToIntConversion helper.
Registration thunk: passes the address of a free-callback routine (sub_5876A0) to the shared BooleanToIntConversion helper.
Registration thunk: passes the address of a cleanup routine (sub_5876E0) to the shared BooleanToIntConversion helper.
Registration thunk: passes the address of a free-callback routine (sub_587A70) to the shared BooleanToIntConversion helper.
CRT file close: flush buffered writes, release the stream lock, close the OS handle at +0x10, free the internal buffer at +0x1C, and unconditionally reset the state flags at +0xC.
Lock-guarded delegation wrapper: acquire a critical-section state, run the stream operation sub_58C43C while held, release the lock, and return its result.

CRT seek/tell: validate open state (flags bit 0x83) and seek mode, clear flag bit 0x10, flush, perform the OS seek on the handle at +0x10, and map the result to 0/-1; sets errno 22 on the invalid path.

MSVC CRT stack probe (_alloca_probe): walk the stack pointer down in 4096-byte strides touching each page while the allocation size is >= 0x1000, returning via the bare retn pushed by the alloca call site.

Locale-aware string-to-double parser: skip leading whitespace using the character-type table or encoding fallback, call Strlen, then delegate to EncodingLocaleDetectionFromParseResult and return the double at parse-result offset 16.

Buffered file write over a stream context: block-size selection (default 4096), internal buffer drain, byte alignment, flush, and direct raw-write fallback on the handle at +0x16; sets the 0x20 error flag on failure and returns the fully-written element count.
Variadic wrapper that packs a local argument descriptor with the raw pointer a1, its Strlen length, a1 again, and constant 73, then delegates format/argument handling to sub_58E4D2.

Network session parameter configuration: indexed accessor for session 1..5, LC_-prefixed key=value config-string parsing against a parameter table, or generic tokenized config against the existing session array, all serialized under critical section 19.

FPU helper: classify NaN/Inf inputs by exponent field and payload class, dispatching to math-error or conditional-math paths, and apply MSVC CRTR rounding to normal numbers while saving/restoring the FPU control word.
Delete a file via DeleteFileA and normalize the result to 0 (success) or -1 (failure), capturing GetLastError and dispatching the failure code through the error lookup handler.

Buffered single-character write: decrement the capacity counter at a2[1], take the overflow path through sub_58CF35 when it goes negative, otherwise store the byte at the cursor a2[0], all under a critical-section lock.
Character uppercase conversion: locale-aware thread-safe path with interlocked ref-counting and optional critical section, or a simple ASCII path subtracting 32 for 'a'..'z'.

Critical-section-guarded stream write wrapper: acquire the buffer lock, read a flag, perform the write via sub_58D04D, conditionally clear struct fields, release the lock, and return the write result.
Single-line allocation wrapper forwarding the requested size plus the global allocation context dword_8D41B0 to NhMalloc.
NULL-safe deallocation dispatcher: OS-version discriminator selects pool-free (3) or validation (2) paths under critical section 9, with a HeapFree fallback when no owning allocation is reported.

CRT stream logical position / remaining-bytes calculator: query the physical file size, clamp the buffered position, adjust for text-mode newline expansion via the per-handle text-mode descriptor, and set errno 22 on invalid mode flags.
CRT error-code mapper: store the OS code into the _doserrno TLS slot, scan the DWORD-pair error table, and apply range fallbacks to errno 13/8/22.

classes.name: CrtFileStream
classes.responsibility: MSVC CRT FILE-layout buffered stream object: close, seek/tell, position query, and buffered block writes over the OS handle at +0x10, with state flags at +0xC and internal buffer at +0x0.

classes.name: LockedStreamBuffer
classes.responsibility: Critical-section-guarded buffered stream primitive family: single-byte buffered writes with overflow handling, locked write wrappers, and lock-guarded delegation over a shared buffer-control object.

classes.name: LockedQueueListOwner
classes.responsibility: Owner object holding an embedded singly-linked node list (head/tail/iterator/count at +0x57C..+0x588) guarded by a mutex handle at +0x58C with timeout at +0x590; drains queued items during shutdown, dispatching each via its vtable slot at offset 0x5C and releasing the mutex on return.

classes.name: CallbackRegistrationDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Family of registration stubs that cast a routine code address to int and delegate registration to the shared BooleanToIntConversion helper; the routines being registered (cleanup, static-init, free-callback) are opaque to this family.

classes.name: RenderStateBitmapAllocator
classes.responsibility: Seeded initialization for a render-state object that registers bitmap-allocation tracker entries on member offsets 52..68 with mode flags and finalizes bitmap fields; the field layout behind those offsets is not evidenced.

classes.name: BitfieldEncoder
classes.responsibility: Bitfield utilities over a byte array: single-bit set/clear and multi-bit run encoding driven by a run-descriptor array.

classes.name: SharedConfigFieldReader
classes.responsibility: Trivial getter for the dword at offset 0x14 of an unidentified object read across AI, network, sound and game-filter paths; only the offset is evidenced, the owning type and field meaning are unknown.

classes.name: StackProbeHelper
classes.responsibility: MSVC CRT _alloca_probe: touches 4096-byte stack strides so OS guard pages fire during large-frame growth, returning via the bare retn pushed by the alloca call site.

classes.name: DoubleParseHelper
classes.responsibility: Locale-aware string-to-double parsing: whitespace skip with encoding-aware character classification, Strlen, then locale parse-result extraction.

classes.name: VariadicStringFormatHelper
classes.responsibility: Variadic wrapper that packs a pointer/length descriptor and a constant, delegating format and argument handling to sub_58E4D2.

classes.name: NetworkSessionParameterConfigurator
classes.responsibility: Network session parameter configuration: indexed accessor for session 1..5, LC_-prefixed key=value config-string parsing against a parameter table, or generic tokenized config against the existing session array, serialized under critical section 19.

classes.name: FpuNumberHelper
classes.responsibility: FPU numeric helper: NaN/Inf classification and dispatch plus normal-number rounding while preserving the FPU control word.

classes.name: FileDeleteHelper
classes.responsibility: Win32 file-deletion wrapper normalizing DeleteFileA results to 0 (success) / -1 (failure) with GetLastError capture and error lookup dispatch.

classes.name: LocaleCharacterNormalizer
classes.responsibility: Character uppercase conversion: locale-aware thread-safe path with interlocked ref-counting and optional critical section, or a fast ASCII path.

classes.name: MemoryAllocatorDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Central allocation entry points: sized allocation forwarded to NhMalloc with the allocation-context global, and NULL-safe deallocation dispatched by an OS-version discriminator with a HeapFree fallback.

classes.name: CrtErrorLookupTable
classes.responsibility: CRT error-code mapper: stores doserrno, scans the DWORD-pair error table, applies range fallbacks to errno 13/8/22, and writes the mapped errno into the TLS slot.

state_machines.name: AllocationFreeDispatch
transitions: dword_8D4908 == 3 -> discriminator-pool-free (sub_593E1B lookup then sub_593E46 paired free)
dword_8D4908 == 2 -> discriminator-validation (sub_594B76 heap-region lookup then CounterThreshold)
specialized path reporting no owning allocation -> heapfree-fallback

state_machines.name: FpuNumberClassification
transitions: nan-or-inf with class 1..2 -> benign-class-1-2 (restore control word, return input)
nan-or-inf with other positive class -> conditional-math-other (dispatch code 8)

interfaces.name: CleanupCallbackRegistration
interfaces.purpose: Uniform mechanism by which the code addresses of cleanup, static-init and free-callback routines are passed to the shared BooleanToIntConversion registration helper.

interfaces.name: BufferedStreamIo
interfaces.purpose: Buffered read/write/tell/close primitives over the CRT FILE-layout stream object.

compatibility_contracts.name: CrtFileStreamLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Replacement must preserve the CRT FILE-layout stream object: buffer end at +0x0, buffered position at +0x4, read pointer at +0x8, state flags at +0xC (bits 0x83 open/writeable, 0x108 write-back, 0x10C buffered, 0x20 error), low flag byte at +0xD, OS handle at +0x10, buffer size at +0x18, freeable buffer pointer at +0x1C.

compatibility_contracts.name: CrtErrnoMapping
compatibility_contracts.description: Error-code semantics: invalid stream operations set errno 22 (EINVAL); ErrorIDLookupTable stores the OS code in the _doserrno TLS slot and maps it with range fallbacks 0x13..0x24 -> errno 13, 0xBC..0xCA -> errno 8, otherwise errno 22.

compatibility_contracts.name: MutexGuardedDrainSemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: The shutdown drain treats WaitForSingleObject results 0 (WAIT_OBJECT_0) and 128 (WAIT_ABANDONED) as access granted, and always releases the mutex at +0x58C on the return path when the handle is non-null.

compatibility_contracts.name: SizedAllocationEntryPoints
compatibility_contracts.description: Allocation goes through MallocWrapperForNhMalloc(size) forwarding to NhMalloc(size, dword_8D41B0); deallocation through FreeMemoryDispatched dispatches on dword_8D4908 (3 = pool-free pair, 2 = heap-region validation) with a HeapFree(hHeap, 0, lpMem) fallback and a NULL-safe early return.

unresolved: Identity and semantic target of the vtable method at offset 0x5C (+92) that DrainTwoListsWithMutexCleanup_B dispatches per drained queue item are unknown.

The first-drain queue behind sub_584E30 is not structurally identified; the meaning of its nonzero return and of the popped value is unknown, and whether it shares the embedded list at this+0x57C is unresolved.
The node payload layout (node[0] data, node[1] next, node+8 flag byte) is inferred from decompiler output and has no dedicated evidence references in the packet.
The semantic role of SEHGuardedFunctionWithExceptionHandling (0x005867B0) on drained node payloads (cleanup callback vs notification) is unknown.
Whether treating WaitForSingleObject result 128 (WAIT_ABANDONED) as access granted is intentional behavior is unconfirmed.
The meaning of the bitmap-allocation mode flags 1, 8, 2, 16 passed to BitmapAllocationTracker, and the render-state field layout behind member offsets 52..68, are unknown.
The consumer of BitSetClearOperation's branch-dependent returned mask (mask vs ~mask) is not identified.

The meaning of the constant 73 and the exact descriptor layout consumed by sub_58E4D2 in the variadic formatting wrapper are unknown; whether a2 is a format string or an output buffer depends on the callee.
The exact conditions under which the generic network-config parse path reaches the final sub_588D95 session initialization are inferred from goto-woven control flow, not proven.
Semantics of the FPU dispatch constants 8 and 11, and of UtilityFunction_1d2e classification values beyond 1..2 vs 3, are unknown.
The interlocked counter dword_8D5A5C and flag dword_8D5A58 (thread/critical-section bookkeeping) and the literal critical-section identifier 19 are inferred, not confirmed.
The exact roles of the flag bits 0x108/0x10C/0x20, the 0x400/0x200 window logic, and the condition setting buffer size +0x18 to 512 in the stream paths are observed but semantically unconfirmed.
The meaning of the allocation-context global dword_8D41B0 and the NhMalloc contract (alignment, failure behavior, ownership) are outside this packet.
Semantics of the OS-version discriminator pair sub_593E1B/sub_593E46 and of MemoryRegionValidationHeapLookup/CounterThreshold are not evidenced by this packet.
The meaning of field 0x14 read by SharedConfigFieldReader, and its owning object type, are unidentified.
The object type of the LockedStreamBuffer control structure beyond the cursor a2[0] and capacity counter a2[1] is not evidenced.
